reads.title: #backend-team — Acme Workspace
reads.text:
Priya Raman 10:42 The checkout latency spiked to 2.4 seconds after yesterday's deploy. Any idea what changed?
Sardor 10:44 I traced it to the orders query. We added a join on shipments without an index, so Postgres falls back to a sequential scan on 8 million rows.
Priya Raman 10:45 Can we just add the index in production?
Sardor 10:47 Yes, but create it concurrently so we don't lock writes. I'd also cache the shipment status in Redis with a 30 second TTL.
Tomas Lindqvist 10:52 I set up the Kubernetes autoscaler last week, unrelated but fyi.

reads.title: orderService.ts — checkout-api
PROJ-4821 Checkout latency regression
reads.text:
Assignee Sardor Astanov  Reporter Priya Raman  Status In Review
Root Cause: migration 0412 introduced a LEFT JOIN with no supporting index. p95 rose from 310 ms to 2400 ms.
Fix: added index concurrently, 30 second Redis cache, support dashboard routed to the read replica.
